deepseek-stats.description: Query your DeepSeek account balance in VS Code and view hourly / daily / monthly balance trend charts
deepseek-stats.command.toggleStatusBar.t: DeepSeek Stats: Toggle Status Bar Balance
deepseek-stats.configuration.title: DeepSeek Stats
deepseek-stats.config.language.descripti: Interface language for DeepSeek Stats. "Auto" follows VS Code's display language; other extensions' UI may still follow VS Code's language.
deepseek-stats.config.language.enum.auto: Auto: follow VS Code's display language
deepseek-stats.config.pollInterval.descr: Balance polling interval in minutes. While VS Code is open, the balance is queried on this interval.
deepseek-stats.config.statusBarShow.desc: Whether to show the balance in the status bar.
deepseek-stats.config.statusBarDefaultCo: Default color for the status bar balance (when no threshold matches). Leave empty to follow the theme's default color.
deepseek-stats.config.statusBarThreshold: Set status bar colors by balance threshold. The first rule whose below condition matches is applied, in order.
Use this color when the balance is below this value (exclusive)
deepseek-stats.config.rawRetention.descr: Number of days to keep raw minute-level snapshots (source for the hourly view). Older data is automatically rolled up into daily records.
deepseek-stats.config.showTodaySpend.des: Show today's spend at the top of the panel (an estimate that may be inaccurate due to top-ups or data gaps; must be consented to before enabling).
deepseek-stats.config.connectorStyle.des: Line style used to connect data gaps in the chart.
deepseek-stats.config.connectorStyle.enu: Pretend continuous: draw gaps as normal continuous data
deepseek-stats.config.connectorColor.des: Color of the chart gap connector lines. Leave empty to follow the chart's main line color.
deepseek-stats.config.lineStyle.descript: How the chart's main line is drawn: straight or smooth.
deepseek-stats.config.dayBoundary.descri: Day boundary timezone for "today's spend". DeepSeek calculates daily usage in UTC; choosing UTC makes today's spend match the official numbers.
deepseek-stats.config.dayBoundary.enum.l: Local timezone (default): today's spend uses the local calendar day
deepseek-stats.config.dayBoundary.enum.u: UTC: matches DeepSeek's official usage day boundary
